account.title: Your account
account.description: Your name is the only thing you can change here. Email, roles and status are somebody else's to set — an operator who could promote themselves would not need the guard that stops them.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs out every other session and leaves this one signed in.
password.note: You will be asked for your current password. Your other devices stay signed out until they use the new one.

dialog.description: Signing out your other sessions is the point of a password change, so it is not optional. Nothing forces a change again afterwards.

currentPassword.description: Required even though you are signed in — a stolen session must not be able to set a new password.

newPassword.description: Every other session is signed out. This one stays signed in.

outcomes.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Every other session was signed out; this one stays.
